issue_context.title: Comparison for Array and List with masked out values is wrong when broadcasting
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl
import io
s = pl.Series('a', [None, [None]], pl.List(pl.Int64)) # Alternatively pl.Array(pl.Int64, 1)
filt = pl.Series('f', [False, True])

df = pl.DataFrame([ s, filt ])

concatted_df = pl.concat([df[:1], df[1:]])

print(df.with_row_index().filter(pl.col.f))
print(concatted_df.with_row_index().filter(pl.col.f))

df.with_row_index().filter(pl.col.f).equals(concatted_df.with_row_index().filter(pl.col.f))
```


### Log output

```shell
False
```

review_comments:
empty chunks 🥲
Ai, how do we get those?
The filter goes through a the `binary_unchecked_same_type` kernel, which takes the filter `op` as `Fn(Array, Array) -> Array` - so if the predicate was false for an entire chunk it ends up empty

https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/8c39bb9f4fd1dd0baba596a60fbdaa7c109432fb/crates/polars-core/src/chunked_array/ops/arity.rs#L535-L541
